login.title: Welcome back
login.description: Sign in to continue to Mimir.
login.justRegisteredDescription: We sent a verification link to your email. Click it, then sign in below.

register.title: Create your account
register.description: Sign up in seconds — no credit card.

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.description: Enter the email on your account. We'll send you a reset link.
forgot.successDescription: If an account exists for that email, we sent a reset link. It expires in 60 minutes.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.description: Pick something strong. You'll use this to sign in.
reset.missingTokenDescription: This link is missing the reset token. Request a new one from the <forgotLink>forgot password</forgotLink> page.
reset.failed: Reset failed. The link may have expired.

verify.title: Verify your email
verify.description: Confirm your address so you can start studying.
verify.successDescription: You're all set. <signInLink>Sign in</signInLink> to continue.
verify.failedDescription: The link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one below.
verify.missingTokenDescription: Open the verification link from the email we sent you, or request a new link below.
verify.resendHint: If an unverified account exists for that email, a new link is on its way.

requireVerified.title: Verify your email to continue
requireVerified.description: We sent a link to {{email}}. Click it to unlock study modes and everything else on your account.

oauth.failedDescription: The {{provider}} sign-in didn't complete. Try again from the login page.

settings.title: Account
settings.description: Manage your profile, password, and account state.

password.title: Change password
password.description: You'll stay signed in on this device.
password.successDescription: Use the new password on your next sign-in.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.description: Permanently removes your account, sets, and study history. This cannot be undone.
delete.dialogDescription: Type your username {{username}} to confirm. Your account is scheduled for deletion immediately.
delete.failed: Deletion failed. Try again or contact support.
